# Aetheris AI

> B2B AI consulting and technology firm in Indianapolis, Indiana, serving US businesses. We embed as a Co-CEO to expose revenue leaks, rebuild broken systems, and deploy AI automation that delivers measurable ROI.

## Core Services
- [AI Strategy & Consulting](https://aetheris.technology/services): AI strategy, digital transformation, use case prioritization, AI maturity assessment, build vs. buy analysis, AI ROI analysis
- [Governance & Ethics](https://aetheris.technology/services): Responsible AI, AI ethics, GDPR/EU AI Act compliance, bias mitigation, explainable AI (XAI), AI risk management
- [Technology & Applications](https://aetheris.technology/services): Generative AI, machine learning, NLP, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, computer vision
- [Marketing & Operations](https://aetheris.technology/services): Automation strategy, AI agents for operations, workflow automation, data analytics, performance optimization, conversational AI

## Signature Engagement
- [14-Day Operational Systems Diagnostic](https://aetheris.technology/assessment): $7,500 flat ($535/day). 14-day operational breakdown identifying workflow inefficiencies, disconnected systems, manual waste, and automation opportunities. If meaningful operational gaps are not identified, the engagement continues at no extra cost.

## Free Tools
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://aetheris.technology/assessment): 2-minute AI maturity scoring across automation, CRM, and adoption.
- [Business Diagnostic](https://aetheris.technology/business-diagnostic): 20-question diagnostic identifying revenue leaks across marketing, conversion, branding, systems, and growth.
- [Website Gap Analysis](https://aetheris.technology/scan): 30-second AI-powered website scan for SEO, weak CTAs, and missed conversions.
